title: No-Bake Energy Bites
description: Chewy oat, peanut butter and chocolate chip balls sweetened with honey. Stir, roll and chill: a snack to keep in the fridge all week.
equipment: Tray or plate lined with parchment

image.alt: Oat and peanut butter energy bites with chocolate chips

steps.text: Stir the oats, peanut butter, honey, chocolate chips, chia seeds, vanilla and salt together until evenly combined.
Chill the mixture for {time 20 min} so it’s easier to shape.
Roll into {count 20} balls about {len 1 in} across, squeezing firmly so they hold together, and set them on the lined tray.
Chill until firm, about {time 30 min notimer}.

notes: If the mix is too dry to hold together, add a spoonful more peanut butter; if too sticky, a few more oats.
Keeps a week in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer.
Use maple syrup instead of honey for a vegan version, with dairy-free chocolate chips.
